title: Geometric Clock Construct
description: A surreal abstract composition on black featuring a central white analog clock with yellow sunburst rays, surrounded by colorful geometric polygons in teal, magenta, purple, blue, and yellow. Black and white line-drawn scaffolding, ladders, hanging rings, and a small crouched human figure are integrated into the mechanical structure.
prompt: Surreal abstract artwork on black background with a central white analog clock emitting yellow sun rays, surrounded by floating colorful geometric shapes including teal, magenta, purple, blue and yellow polygons.
